record.body:
## Evidence

NeedsYouDetailScreen.show swallows NoMatches unless all panels exist, EffortPane.show returns when #goal is missing, NeedsYouDetailScreen.follow returns before mount, and wait_workers swallows WorkerCancelled. No test proves the guards.

## Consequence

Phase merge is blocked until the finding is fixed or cleared.

## Follow-up

The user decides: keep the guards, or remove them and accept the flaky dashboard tests.
